title: Concept: Dependency pinned to a prerelease build
description: package.json declares an exact pin to a prerelease build, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Prerelease builds carry no stability promise and are frequently outside advisory ranges, so a known defect can ship while the pin looks deliberate and exact.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: Prerelease builds carry no stability promise and are frequently outside advisory ranges, so a known defect can ship while the pin looks deliberate and exact.
